attributes.title: TICKET-006: Make sign-out final and idempotent
attributes.body:
# TICKET-006: Make sign-out final and idempotent
## Observable goal
Authenticated and anonymous sign-out are safe, and an ended session cannot authorize later actions.
## Source IDEA, EPIC, version, and scenario IDs
IDEA-009/v003; EPIC-002/v002; SCENARIO-017, SCENARIO-018, SCENARIO-019.
## Acceptance evidence
Request specs prove authenticated and anonymous sign-out plus rejection of a captured session after sign-out.
## Dependencies
TICKET-004
## Difficulty (1-5)
2
## Estimate (ideal days, at most 2)
0.5
## Risks
Routing and CSRF safety; replayed cookies must fail after session termination.
## External actions
none
## Allowed scope
Logout route/response, session termination, destination, translations, and focused specs consuming TICKET-004's invalidation mechanism.

<!-- product-factory-ticket-id: TICKET-006 -->
